description: There are two trees we would like to prune, both are yews ( Taxus baccata ). Tree 2 ( marked on plan )-Nearer West Temple Sheen - reduce 2 metres all around to shape and contain, reduce on building side by 2 metres to ensure foliage clear of church and also by 2 metres so not overhanging the pavement. Also to lift the lower branches by 1 metre to give more clearance for the Church Notice Board. This Yew, Tree 2 is touching the Church (Grade 2 listed) in places and also over the pavement which has a very high usage particularly because of the school ( Sheen Mount ) opposite the Church on West Temple Sheen. It is also growing over a traffic control zone/school indicator sign. Also to reduce 2 metres on Christchurch Road side where the tree is overhanging the pavement and 2 metres on the Eastern side and of the Crown/height to ensure symmetry and aesthetic look. Tree 3 is further from West Temple Sheen - reduce by 1 metre all around to shape and contain, reduce on building side to ensure clear of church also by 1 metre and to lift lower branches by 1 metre. We appreciate that we will also require the approval of Southwark Diocese to carry out this work and will be in contact with the Diocese accordingly.
